{{Term/Store|Hero's Path Mode||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring mode in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref name="Hero">{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Red|Hero's Path mode}} unlocked. Press {{Icon|BotW X}} on the map to see your journey's path thus far.|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|{{Color TotK|Red|Hero's path mode}} unlocked. Press {{Icon|TotK X}} on the map screen to see your journey's path thus far.|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Hero's Path Mode tracks every step [[Link]] has taken during the last 200 hours.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= This new map feature shows the path Link has walked through Hyrule from the last 200 hours of gameplay.|author= |published= |retrieved= June 3, 2017|url= http://zelda.com/breath-of-the-wild/news/expansion-pass-dlc-pack-1-detailed/|title= Expansion Pass DLC Pack 1 Detailed|site= Zelda.com|type=}}</ref> This path appears on the Map as a green line that follows Link's steps. The process can be sped up, paused, and skipped.

Upon obtaining {{TMT|-}} and opening the [[Sheikah Slate]]'s [[Map]], a notice will appear informing Link that Hero's Path Mode has been unlocked.<ref name="Hero"/>
